statement.zh: 豪尔萨巴德（杜尔沙鲁金）萨尔贡二世宫殿、宫殿神庙与城门发掘见 Loud OIP 38（1936），含 Frankfort、Jacobsen 章节。
statement.en: At Khorsabad (Dur-Sharrukin), excavations in Sargon II’s palace, palace temples, and a city gate are documented in Loud OIP 38 (1936), with chapters by Frankfort and Jacobsen.
